name: .NET Standard-only library migration blocker
description: Flags projects that only target .NET Standard because they can obscure the concrete runtime and application migration target.
impact: .NET Standard-only libraries may need explicit retargeting or multi-targeting decisions before application modernization can complete.
evidenceRequirements: Project target framework metadata must be available from extracted project facts.
recommendedActions: Decide whether the library should multi-target or move to the repository's supported concrete .NET target.
